status: planning acceptance matrix; not executed fixtures

cases.initial_condition: A documentation-only task with known requirements
cases.expected_outcome: Plan stays proportional; preserves PR policy; creates no source stubs or irrelevant test mandates

cases.initial_condition: Bug fix in a module with existing interface and tests
cases.expected_outcome: Reuses contract; captures meaningful validation; completes one behavior-sized green commit

cases.initial_condition: Universal workflow starts an active simple plan with no remote PR
cases.expected_outcome: Workflow prepares exactly one PR before review; execute does not independently publish

cases.initial_condition: PR exists but context has no PR record
cases.expected_outcome: Queries matching repository/head/base; persists identity; no second create

cases.initial_condition: Checks pass but commit hook fails
cases.expected_outcome: No completed todo until intended commit succeeds

cases.initial_condition: Commit succeeded but todo/context update was interrupted
cases.expected_outcome: Identifies intended commit and reconciles progress without duplicate commit

cases.initial_condition: Clean --no-worktree branch with committed changes
cases.expected_outcome: Summary includes actual branch diff and appends summary path; does not claim merged

cases.initial_condition: Phase 1 merged/summarized; phase 2 pending or active
cases.expected_outcome: Only phase 1 worktree removed; pending plans/state/unknown fields preserved

cases.initial_condition: Archive interrupted after snapshot creation or worktree removal
cases.expected_outcome: Snapshot retained without collision/overwrite; no second archive of fresh context

cases.initial_condition: Archive target has uncommitted user work
cases.expected_outcome: Worktree and user changes preserved; no force remove

cases.initial_condition: PR open and phase summarized
cases.expected_outcome: Final archive does not erase unfinished task; reports missing merge

cases.initial_condition: Approval references old commit; variants change PR head before inspection or between validation and merge request
cases.expected_outcome: Old approval cannot satisfy gate; merge request is guarded by validated SHA, concurrent change rejects it, and no unreviewed head merges

cases.initial_condition: Host cannot spawn independent reviewer
cases.expected_outcome: Reports limitation; self-review not represented as independent approval

cases.initial_condition: PR current head has required check failure
cases.expected_outcome: No merge or completed phase; reports failing check

cases.initial_condition: PR merged remotely before metadata update
cases.expected_outcome: Reconciles merged state without duplicate merge; verifies next phase base

cases.initial_condition: Legacy phase completed/free-form approval with open or unknown PR
cases.expected_outcome: Does not infer merge/approval; recovers unambiguous facts or reports unknown

cases.initial_condition: Context has research, workflow and custom fields
cases.expected_outcome: Updates owned fields only; preserves unrelated keys and deduplicates references

cases.initial_condition: Fixture remote/base named upstream/trunk
cases.expected_outcome: Resolves correct base, diff and branch ancestry without origin/main assumption

cases.initial_condition: Research-only, branch-only, per-phase and summarized-unmerged variants
cases.expected_outcome: Read-only status uses defined precedence and correct next action

cases.initial_condition: Initialize a project with existing context and AGENTS content
cases.expected_outcome: Creates only missing structure; existing work and guidance retained

cases.initial_condition: Research references an earlier revision with a changed relevant contract
cases.expected_outcome: Reopens changed facts; retains evidence and gaps without broad redundant exploration

cases.initial_condition: User request has answers in provided research/project config
cases.expected_outcome: Inspects available facts and asks only unresolved material questions

cases.initial_condition: Changed code has one reproducible defect and one harmless style choice
cases.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed blocker for defect; style does not block approval

cases.initial_condition: Runtime client identity unavailable
cases.expected_outcome: Exact-name natural language preserves canonical skill identifiers

cases.initial_condition: Only target skill and its bundled resources available
cases.expected_outcome: References resolve or explicit safe limitation/fallback; no invented full workflow support

cases.initial_condition: Approved simple plan and clean fixture
cases.expected_outcome: One full workflow reaches verified merge and one final archive without creating phase plans/metadata

cases.initial_condition: Approved two-phase plan and clean fixture
cases.expected_outcome: Two PRs merged in dependency order; phase cleanup preserves next phase; one final archive

cases.initial_condition: User invokes execute directly for a valid plan
cases.expected_outcome: Local implementation/validation completes; no PR publication or implicit review/merge/archive

cases.initial_condition: Context JSON is malformed with unrelated user notes and files
cases.expected_outcome: Report parse failure before mutation; preserve all original bytes and request resolution

cases.initial_condition: Two active checkouts contain plausible contexts and no authoritative root is identified
cases.expected_outcome: Ask which context root owns this task before writing; preserve both checkouts
